description: Model inventory (P4, SR 11-7 spirit). One governed entry per pricer/trade-type: the model + QuantLib engine, key assumptions, known limitations, approved use, and the independent control(s) that verify it. The governance coverage check fails if a portfolio trade-type has no entry.

stock.name: Cash equity / ETF mark-to-market
assumptions: spot = latest daily close on/before valuation date
trailing-12m dividend yield (diagnostic only)
limitations: no borrow/repo or hard-to-borrow cost
no corporate-action handling beyond split-adjusted closes
stock.approved_use: delta-bearing cash positions and option/CDS underliers

ois_swap.name: SOFR overnight-indexed swap
ois_swap.engine: ql.MakeOIS on a SOFR curve bootstrapped from Pensford forward-derived par-OIS quotes
assumptions: par-OIS rates derived from the Pensford monthly forward-SOFR grid
Act/360, annual fixed
discount = forecast = one SOFR curve (multi-curve-ready interface)
limitations: no Term-SOFR/Fed-funds basis
curve bootstrapped to 30Y (12Y/15Y/20Y are real Pensford nodes; 30Y is constant-forward extrapolated past the ~20Y data horizon)
no realized-SOFR fixings wired (C4) — latent: every trade spot-starts so no in-accrual period exists; a seasoned OIS would need nyfed_sofr fixings via IndexManager.addFixing

european_swaption.name: European swaption
european_swaption.model: Bachelier (normal) on the forward swap rate
assumptions: normal (Bachelier) vol at the option expiry from a MOVE-anchored term structure (C1)
single SOFR curve
limitations: expiry-dependent vol comes from a STYLIZED MOVE-anchored shape (config multiplier), not a market surface
flat across strike (no smile); a real cube needs licensed data — the free DTCC SDR IR-options feed is not calibratable

bermudan_swaption.name: Bermudan swaption
assumptions: Hull-White calibrated to co-terminal European swaptions
each co-terminal target uses the normal vol at ITS expiry from the MOVE-anchored term structure (C1), so the vol slope identifies the mean reversion
limitations: 1-factor (no curve-shape optionality)
the vol term structure is a stylized MOVE-anchored shape, not a market surface; flat across strike (no smile)
ipv_controls: tree engine vs FD engine cross-check (rel diff < 2%)

cap.name: Interest-rate cap
assumptions: normal vol at the cap's expiry from a MOVE-anchored term structure (C1)
single SOFR curve
limitations: expiry-dependent vol from a stylized MOVE-anchored shape, not a market surface; flat across strike; no caplet stripping

corp_bond.name: Corporate fixed-rate bullet
corp_bond.model: Z-spread discounting (term structure where the CDS feed supports it)
corp_bond.engine: ql FixedRateBond on SpreadedLinearZeroInterpolatedTermStructure(SOFR, issuer Z-spread curve) when the issuer CDS feed gives >=2 tenors; else ZeroSpreadedTermStructure(SOFR, flat Z-spread)
assumptions: issuer Z-spread(s) = per-tenor DTCC single-name CDS par spread + maturity-interpolated SOFR-Treasury basis (A3); config fallback bp for issuers with no clean CDS (AAPL/MSFT/AMZN)
5Y headline pins the curve's 5Y node
limitations: term structure only where the CDS feed supports it (ORCL ~2-3 tenors); thin names (META) and fallback issuers stay flat
Z-spread flat-extrapolated past the last CDS tenor (bonds run to 2053/2054, CDS quotes reach ~5Y)
CDS->bond basis held at zero
SOFR base curve reaches 30Y (A1)
corp_bond.approved_use: senior unsecured corporate BULLETS only — all book bonds are non-callable; a callable/make-whole would need CallableFixedRateBond + a tree engine and report OAS not Z-spread (C6, not built until a callable enters the book)

ust_bond.name: US Treasury (on-the-run)
ust_bond.engine: ql FixedRateBond on a par-bond-bootstrapped UST curve
assumptions: par yields from Treasury.gov
ActualActual(Bond), semiannual
limitations: on-the-run only; no repo/specialness

equity_option.name: Listed equity option (single-name / index)
equity_option.engine: AnalyticEuropeanEngine (European) / FdBlackScholesVanillaEngine (American); one BSM process per leg with its strike's IV
assumptions: spot + continuous dividend yield recovered from the option chain via put-call parity
per-(expiry,strike) IV from the chain (skew-aware)
risk-free = SOFR curve

American legs on dividend payers price with a projected discrete ex-dividend schedule (B1), scaled to preserve the chain-implied forward so only early-exercise timing changes; other legs use the continuous yield
limitations: single 2026-06-17 chain snapshot
discrete dividends projected from the historical feed (latest amount held, cadence rolled forward); non-payers (TSLA)/index (SPX) and European legs stay on the continuous yield

full BlackVarianceSurface built & shown (B2) but NOT fed to the FD engine as local vol — Dupire local vol from the sparse free chain is unstable/over-prices short options; each leg prices at its own exact (strike,expiry) IV instead
no stochastic vol
equity_option.approved_use: listed vanilla single-stock (American) and index (European) options and their combinations; the VIX term complex / SKEW / single-name vol indices are risk-vega factors only, not pricing inputs (C3) — each chain carries the authoritative skew+term surface
ipv_controls: finite-difference delta vs analytic delta_shares (rel diff < 3%)

cds.name: Credit default swap (single-name / index)
cds.model: ISDA standard; piecewise-flat hazard curve (flat fallback)
cds.engine: ql IsdaCdsEngine on a hazard curve: single names with >=2 clean tenors bootstrap a piecewise-flat HazardRateCurve (sequential secant, each tenor's par CDS reprices to 0); thin names / index use one flat hazard (QL 1.42 has no IsdaCdsHelper)
assumptions: par-spread term structure from DTCC (single-name SEC path / index CFTC UPI); 5Y headline on a tight window, non-5Y tenors on a wider window; config fallback per name
flat-forward SOFR discount (IsdaCdsEngine requirement)
40% recovery
limitations: free DTCC feed trades mostly the on-the-run 5Y, so the term structure is sparse (ORCL ~2-3 tenors; META/CDX stay flat)
hazard extrapolated flat past the last quoted tenor

index (B4) priced at the untranched index level (flat hazard from the quoted index spread, standard fixed coupon + upfront, on traded x index_factor); index_factor=1.0 for the current on-the-run (no free defaulted-name data); no constituent-curve aggregation or tranche granularity
requires discount-curve reference date == valuation date
cds.approved_use: single-name and CDX.NA.IG index CDS; single names price on a bootstrapped hazard term structure where the feed supports it; the index at the untranched index level
risk_measures: rec01 (+1pt recovery, spread held constant — B5)
cds.notes: B5: if the tight 5Y bucket is thin the headline widens to the longer window, then to the nearest standard tenor as a proxy, before the config fallback.

fx_forward.name: FX forward / NDF
fx_forward.engine: DF_usd (SOFR) and DF_foreign (flat foreign rate); foreign leg at current spot
assumptions: spot foreign-per-USD: USD/JPY from the ECB cross, USD/TWD from the CBC NDF fixing (B3 — the reference the non-deliverable book settles against, and fresher than Fed H.10)
foreign rate flat (BOJ TONAR overnight / CBC policy constant)
limitations: flat foreign curve; xccy basis via a config hook (xccy_basis_bp, default 0 — no free daily USD/TWD or USD/JPY basis feed) added to the foreign discount rate (C2)
no free JPY-OIS strip (TONAR is overnight-only) or TWD forward points to bootstrap a foreign term structure
TWD rate held as a config constant
fx_forward.approved_use: deliverable FX forwards / NDFs on JPY, TWD
ipv_controls: finite-difference fx-delta vs analytic fx_delta_1pct (rel diff < 3%)

xccy_swap.name: Cross-currency swap
xccy_swap.engine: USD leg on SOFR, foreign leg on a flat foreign curve converted at the CBC NDF-fixing spot
assumptions: fixed-for-fixed simplification of the design-doc MtM-resetting NDS
USD/TWD spot from the CBC NDF fixing (B3)
xccy basis via a config hook, default 0 (no free TAIBOR/basis feed) — C2
limitations: no MtM resets
flat TWD curve (no free forward points); basis = 0 by default (hook ready for a licensed basis); spot is the dominant risk
xccy_swap.approved_use: USD/foreign CCS where spot is the dominant risk
ipv_controls: finite-difference fx-delta vs analytic fx_delta_1pct (rel diff < 3%)
